## Target

What subsystem, executable, file, data table, script, or asset needs investigation?

## Version / revision

List the relevant game release, region, language, revision, update, or build if known.

## Known information

Summarize confirmed facts, offsets, symbols, hashes, formats, or related findings.

## Goal

Describe the result needed: documentation, parser, source reconstruction, symbol map, comparison, verification, etc.

## Verification criteria

How will we know the research result is correct?
